Select Theme

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AlphaDestination
    The Alpha destination (T-12).
    AlphaEffectRule
    Gives the pieces that were teleported to Alpha an Energized or Sick effect by coin toss (T-12).
    ApproachDestination
    The Approach destination (T-11).
    ApproachPassCountRule
    A piece may enter its HomeStraight only after it has passed its Approach cell often enough: once if it is clockwise and twice if it is counter-clockwise (T-1, T-5).
    BaseDestination
    The Base destination (T-11).
    BetaDestination
    The Beta destination (T-13).
    BetaRestrictedState
    The state of a piece that was teleported to Beta (T-13).
    BetaRestrictionApplied
    A teleported piece or blockade cannot move for four rounds (T-13).
    BetaRestrictionAppliedPresenter
    Presents BetaRestrictionApplied: it tells that a piece cannot move for four rounds because of the Beta restriction.
    BetaRestrictionRule
    Roll hook for the Beta restriction (T-13).
    BetaRestrictionTriggered
    Two rolls of 3 in a row sent a Beta-restricted piece or blockade back to Base (T-13).
    BetaRestrictionTriggeredPresenter
    Presents BetaRestrictionTriggered: it tells that a Beta-restricted piece was sent back to Base after two rolls of 3 in a row.
    BetaReturnToBaseCommand
    Sends a Beta-restricted piece or blockade back to Base after two rolls of 3 in a row (T-13).
    BlockadeBreakRule
    Chain of Responsibility where each rule may force a consequence for the roll, for example breaking a blockade on a third six (T-6).
    BlockadeConstants
     
    BlockadeLimitRule
    Chain of Responsibility where each rule may limit the number of steps that a move is allowed to take, for example because of an opponent blockade (T-3).
    BlockCaptured
    A blockade captured an opponent blockade of the same size (T-8).
    BlockCapturedPresenter
    Presents BlockCaptured: it tells that one blockade captured another and that all its pieces return to Base.
    BlockCaptureRule
    A blockade captures an opponent blockade of the same size (T-8).
    BlockDirectionClassifier
    Classifies a blockade by the original directions of its pieces, and gives the type a label (T-4, T-5).
    BlockDirectionType
     
    BlockEffectAssigned
    A coin toss gave a teleported blockade a shared Energized or Sick effect (T-12).
    BlockEffectAssignedPresenter
    Presents BlockEffectAssigned: it tells the shared Energized or Sick effect of a blockade.
    BlockMoved
    A blockade moved.
    BlockMovedPresenter
    Presents BlockMoved: it tells the move of a blockade: its cells, its type and its direction.
    BlockRollTooSmall
    A block's roll was divided down to zero cells, so the block cannot move (T-4).
    BlockRollTooSmallCommand
    Announces that the roll of a block was divided down to zero cells (T-4).
    BlockRollTooSmallPresenter
    Presents BlockRollTooSmall: it says that the roll of a block was divided down to zero cells, so the block cannot move.
    BlockStepsRule
    Chain of Responsibility where each rule may change the number of steps of a blockade move, for example by sharing the roll between its pieces (T-4).
    BlockTravelDirectionStrategy
    Strategy that chooses the direction in which a blockade travels.
    BluePieceRotationIterator
    Iterator that cycles endlessly through the pieces of a player in a fixed order: B1, B2, B3, B4 and then B1 again (T-19).
    BluePlayer
    The blue player.
    BlueStrategy
    Blue moves its pieces in rotation: B1, B2, B3, B4 and then B1 again.
    Board
     
    BoardConstants
     
    BoardStateReported
    The round is over.
    BoardStateReportedPresenter
    Presents BoardStateReported: it writes the report at the end of a round: the piece count of every player and every piece, blockade and effect.
    BreakBlockCommand
    Pieces leave a blockade and get their own direction back, and then each released piece runs its own move (T-5, T-6).
    CannotMoveCommand
    Base class of the commands that only announce why a piece or a block cannot move.
    CaptureBlockCommand
    A blockade captures an opponent blockade of the same size (T-8).
    CaptureCheckRule
    Chain of Responsibility where each rule checks whether the moved piece captures something (rule 7, T-8).
    CapturePieceCommand
    A piece captures an opponent piece (rule 7).
    CaptureTargetFinder
    Finds the opponent piece that a candidate move would capture (T-16, T-18).
    CellNames
    Names a track cell Approach(X) when it is the Approach cell of a colour, and Cell(X) otherwise.
    ChainedRule<R>
    Base class of the Chain of Responsibility.
    ClockwiseMovementStrategy
    Clockwise movement, given by a heads coin toss (T-1).
    CoinToss
    Decides heads or tails, for example for the direction of a piece (T-1).
    CoinTossEntryDirectionAssigner
    Gives a piece its direction by a coin toss: heads means clockwise and tails means counter-clockwise (T-1).
    CoinTossLabels
    Gives the display text of a coin toss result, so the enum stays free of text.
    CoinTossResult
     
    Command
    Command pattern: one action wrapped as an object, so that callers can run it without knowing how it works.
    CommandFinder
    Picks the first command that satisfies a condition of a strategy.
    ConsecutiveSixVoidRule
    A third six in a row is void, and the player makes no move (rule 4).
    ConsoleGameObserver
    Observer that prints every game message on the console.
    CounterClockwiseMovementStrategy
    Counter-clockwise movement, given by a tails coin toss (T-1).
    Dice
    A die that the players roll.
    DiceConstants
     
    DiceRolled
    A player rolled the die during the first-player toss.
    DiceRolledPresenter
    Presents DiceRolled: it tells one roll of the first-player toss.
    DivideByBlockSizeRule
    Shares the roll of a blockade evenly between its pieces, rounded down (T-4).
    EffectActivationRule
    Chain of Responsibility that decides whether an effect may start after a Mystery Cell arrival (T-15).
    EffectConstants
     
    EffectRollTooSmall
    A Sick effect cut the roll down to zero cells, so the piece cannot move (T-12).
    EffectRollTooSmallPresenter
    Presents EffectRollTooSmall: it says that a Sick effect halved the roll down to zero cells, so the piece cannot move.
    EnterBoardCommand
    Brings a piece from Base to its Entry cell (rule 2).
    EnterBoardFirstStrategy
    The default strategy.
    EnterBoardRule
    A piece may leave Base only on a six (rule 2).
    EntryDestination
    The Entry destination (T-11).
    EntryDirection
    The direction given to a piece that leaves Base, and the coin toss that decided it (T-1).
    EntryDirectionAssigner
    Decides in which direction a piece travels when it leaves Base.
    EventPresenter<M>
    Turns one kind of game message into console text.
    ExactRollRequiredCommand
    Announces that an exact roll is needed to reach Home (rule 10).
    ExactRollRule
    Chain of Responsibility where each rule may forbid a move on the HomeStraight that would go past Home (rule 10).
    FirstPlayerSelector
     
    GameEngine
    Plays the turn of one player.
    GameFacade
    Single entry point of the game (Facade pattern).
    GameLoop
    Plays rounds until every player has all pieces Home, and then publishes the final standings.
    GameMessage
    Something that happened in the game, for example a move, a capture or a teleport.
    GameMessageCenter
    The message centre of the game (Singleton).
    GameMessageObserver
    Observer side of the Observer pattern.
    GameMessagePublisher
    Subject side of the Observer pattern.
    GameMessageRegistry
    Registration side of the message centre.
    GameOver
    The game is over.
    GameOverPresenter
    Presents GameOver: it writes the banner with the final standings.
    GameStarting
    The game is about to begin.
    GameStartingPresenter
    Presents GameStarting: it announces the start of the game.
    GammaDestination
    The Gamma destination (T-14).
    GammaDirectionRule
    The rule of the Gamma cell (T-14): a clockwise group reverses its direction for good, and a counter-clockwise group is sent on to Beta.
    GreenPlayer
    The green player.
    GreenStrategy
    Green is blockade-focused.
    HomeEntryPolicy
    What a piece needs before it may leave the track for its HomeStraight.
    HomeGateOpened
    The home gate opened for a colour.
    HomeGateOpenedPresenter
    Presents HomeGateOpened: it tells that the home gate opened for a colour.
    HomeGateStatus
    Read-only view of the home gate.
    HomeGateTracker
    Tracks the home gate (T-7).
    HomeStraightCell
     
    HomeStraightEligibilityRule
    A piece needs a capture before it may enter its HomeStraight, unless the home gate is open for its colour (T-7).
    HomeStraightEntryRule
    Chain of Responsibility that stops a piece from entering its HomeStraight too early (T-1, T-7).
    IllegalMoveException
    Thrown when a move breaks the game rules, for example when a piece at Base or at Home is asked to move, or when a strategy has no legal command to choose from.
    IndividualEffectAssigned
    A coin toss gave a piece its own Energized or Sick effect (T-12).
    IndividualEffectAssignedPresenter
    Presents IndividualEffectAssigned: it tells the own Energized or Sick effect of a piece.
    InvalidPieceStateException
    Thrown when a piece is asked for something its current location cannot give, for example the track position of a piece that is at Base.
    LongestDistanceDirectionStrategy
    A blockade travels in the original direction of its member that is farthest from Home (T-4).
    LudoBoard
     
    Main
    Program entry point of LUDO-T.
    MessagePresenter
    Presents any game message by finding the presenter that is registered for its type.
    MoveBlockCommand
    Moves a blockade as one unit, using one shared direction (T-3).
    MoveBlockedByBlockadeCommand
    Announces that an opponent blockade stops a piece or a block (T-3).
    MoveCommand
    A command that a player strategy may choose for the current roll.
    MovementDirectionStrategy
    Strategy for the two directions in which a piece can travel: clockwise and counter-clockwise.
    MovementEffect
    A movement effect, Energized or Sick, together with the number of rounds it has left (T-12).
    MovementEffectType
     
    MovePieceCommand
    Moves one piece by a number of steps (rule 1).
    MovePiecesRule
    Lists the legal moves of the pieces on the board (rule 1).
    MysteryCellAppeared
    The Mystery Cell appeared for the first time, on a random empty cell (T-10).
    MysteryCellAppearedPresenter
    Presents MysteryCellAppeared: it announces the first appearance of the Mystery Cell in a banner.
    MysteryCellArrival
    Proof that a piece arrived by a genuine Mystery Cell teleport (T-15).
    MysteryCellConstants
     
    MysteryCellDestination
    One place to which a Mystery Cell can send pieces (T-11).
    MysteryCellLocation
    Read-only view of the location of the Mystery Cell (T-19).
    MysteryCellPositions
     
    MysteryCellRelocated
    The Mystery Cell moved to a new cell after four rounds (T-10).
    MysteryCellRelocatedPresenter
    Presents MysteryCellRelocated: it announces that the Mystery Cell moved to a new cell, in a banner.
    MysteryCellSchedule
    Controls when the Mystery Cell appears and where it stands (T-10).
    MysteryCellTeleportCommand
    Teleports pieces from the Mystery Cell to a chosen destination (T-11).
    MysteryCellTeleportRule
    Teleports a piece that lands on the active Mystery Cell to a random destination (T-11).
    MysteryTeleportActivationRule
    Allows an effect only after a genuine teleport arrival (T-15).
    NoPieceMovable
    The roll gave the player nothing to move.
    NoPieceMovablePresenter
    Presents NoPieceMovable: it tells that the roll left nothing to move.
    NoRestrictionState
    The free state: the piece may move (T-13).
    OvershootHomeRule
    A move on the HomeStraight must not go past Home (rule 10).
    PassingBlockadeRule
    Stops a move in front of an opponent blockade (T-3, T-8).
    Piece
    One game piece.
    PieceBlocked
    An opponent's blockade stops a piece or a block (T-3).
    PieceBlockedPresenter
    Presents PieceBlocked: it says that an opponent's blockade stops the piece or the block.
    PieceCaptured
    A piece captured an opponent piece (requirement 4).
    PieceCapturedPresenter
    Presents PieceCaptured: it tells the square where the capture happened, and then the new piece count of the player who lost the piece.
    PieceCaptureRule
    A single piece that lands on a single opponent piece captures it (rule 7).
    PieceCountLine
    Writes the line that tells how many pieces a player has on the board and at Base.
    PieceDirectionAssigned
    The coin toss gave a piece that has just left Base its direction (T-1).
    PieceDirectionAssignedPresenter
    Presents PieceDirectionAssigned: it tells the direction that the coin toss gave to a piece.
    PieceDirectionReversed
    A Gamma teleport reversed the direction of a piece or a blockade (T-14).
    PieceDirectionReversedPresenter
    Presents PieceDirectionReversed: it tells that a Gamma teleport reversed a direction.
    PieceEnteredBoard
    A piece left Base and entered the track.
    PieceEnteredBoardPresenter
    Presents PieceEnteredBoard: it tells that a piece left Base, followed by the piece count of the player.
    PieceEnteredHomeStraight
    A piece or a blockade entered its HomeStraight.
    PieceEnteredHomeStraightPresenter
    Presents PieceEnteredHomeStraight: it tells that a piece or a blockade entered its HomeStraight.
    PieceLabels
    Names a group of pieces with one label, for example R1+R2.
    PieceLeftBlock
    A piece left its blockade and resumes its own direction (T-5).
    PieceLeftBlockPresenter
    Presents PieceLeftBlock: it tells that a piece left its blockade and resumes its own direction.
    PieceLocation
     
    PieceMoved
    A single piece moved.
    PieceMovedPresenter
    Presents PieceMoved: it tells the move of a single piece: the number of steps, the direction and both cells.
    PieceNeedsExactRoll
    A piece on the HomeStraight needs an exact roll to reach Home (rule 10).
    PieceNeedsExactRollPresenter
    Presents PieceNeedsExactRoll: it says that the piece needs an exact roll to reach Home.
    PieceOwnershipException
    Thrown when a player is asked to act on a piece that belongs to another player.
    PieceReachedHome
    A piece or a blockade reached Home and is removed from play.
    PieceReachedHomePresenter
    Presents PieceReachedHome: it tells that a piece or a blockade reached Home and is removed from play.
    PieceRestrictionState
    State pattern: a restriction that can stop a piece from moving (T-13).
    PieceTeleported
    A piece or a blockade landed on the Mystery Cell and was teleported to a random destination (T-11).
    PieceTeleportedPresenter
    Presents PieceTeleported: it tells that a piece landed on the Mystery Cell and where it was teleported.
    Player
    Base class of the four colour players: RedPlayer, YellowPlayer, GreenPlayer and BluePlayer.
    PlayerColor
     
    PlayerColorNames
    Gives the display text of a colour: the full name, such as Red, and the short code, such as R.
    PlayerNotFoundException
    Thrown when no player of the requested colour is in the game.
    PlayerRosterAnnounced
    The pieces of a player are announced before the game begins (3.1).
    PlayerRosterAnnouncedPresenter
    Presents PlayerRosterAnnounced: it announces the pieces of a player before the game begins.
    PlayerStrategy
    Strategy pattern: decides which legal command to run when a roll allows more than one.
    PlayerStrategyLookup
    Finds the strategy that plays for a colour.
    PlayerStrategyRegistry
    Registry of the strategy of each colour.
    PresenterCatalog
    Lists the presenter of every kind of game message in one place.
    RandomNumberGenerator
    A source of random numbers.
    RedPlayer
    The red player.
    RedStrategy
    Red is capture-focused.
    RemainingHomeDistance
    Counts how many cells a piece still has to travel to reach Home.
    RollEvent
    A roll that was accepted for a player.
    RollHook
    Reacts to an accepted roll before the player chooses a move, for example the home gate and the Beta restriction.
    RollValidityRule
    Chain of Responsibility that checks whether a roll is void.
    RoundListener
    Reacts to the start and the end of each round.
    RoundStarted
    A new round begins.
    RoundStartedPresenter
    Presents RoundStarted: it announces the start of a new round.
    RoundTracker
    Counts the rounds of one game and keeps the turn order of the game.
    SeedableRandomNumberGenerator
    A random number source that can be given a seed.
    SeededCoinToss
    The coin of the game (Singleton).
    SeededRandomNumberGenerator
    The only source of randomness in the game (Singleton).
    SickRollTooSmallCommand
    Announces that a Sick effect halved the roll down to zero cells (T-12).
    SixSidedDice
    The die of the game (Singleton).
    StandardCell
     
    StrategyContext
    The situation that a strategy needs to judge the legal commands: the player, all players, the board, the Mystery Cell and the number of the roll.
    TeleportRule
    Decides whether a piece that has just landed is teleported (T-11).
    ThirdSixBlockadeBreakRule
    A third six in a row breaks an existing blockade instead of voiding the roll (T-6).
    ThirdSixVoided
    Three sixes in a row: the roll is void and the turn passes.
    ThirdSixVoidedPresenter
    Presents ThirdSixVoided: it tells that a third six in a row is void and the turn passes.
    TossStarting
    Everyone is about to roll for the first turn.
    TossStartingPresenter
    Presents TossStarting: it announces the start of the first-player toss.
    TossTied
    Two or more players tied for the highest roll, so everyone rolls again.
    TossTiedPresenter
    Presents TossTied: it tells that the toss ended in a tie and everyone rolls again.
    TossWon
    A player won the toss and goes first.
    TossWonPresenter
    Presents TossWon: it tells who won the toss.
    TrackDestination
    Base class of the destinations that lie on the shared track (T-11), written as a Template Method.
    TurnConstants
     
    TurnOrderBuilder
    Builds the clockwise turn order (rule 3) that starts with a given colour.
    TurnOrderLayout
     
    TurnRolled
    A player rolled the die during a turn.
    TurnRolledPresenter
    Presents TurnRolled: it tells the roll of a player during a turn.
    TurnRule
    A rule that reports every legal command for a roll.
    TurnStarted
    The turn of a player begins.
    TurnStartedPresenter
    Presents TurnStarted: it announces the start of the turn of a player.
    UnpresentableMessageException
    Thrown when a game message reaches the console but no presenter is registered for its type.
    YellowPlayer
    The yellow player.
    YellowStrategy
    Yellow is winning-focused.
